business_process: Cold storage of carcasses and customer product
description: Hanging and aging carcasses in the carcass cooler (7 to 14 days); holding packaged product in the walk-in freezer until the owner picks it up; watching temperatures and answering alerts
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: A closed walk-in holds temperature for only a few hours without power or a working unit; one carcass cooler can hold more than $10,000 of customers' beef; temperature abuse can adulterate product (9 CFR 416.4(d) via 303.1(a)(2)(i)); RTO 1 h is the time to restore alerting or start hourly manual checks; RPO 12 h is the gateway's offline buffer
manual_workaround: Read the dial thermometers every hour and write them on the paper log; keep doors shut; call the refrigeration contractor's 24-hour line; move product to emergency cooler space (arrangement planned, not in place)
dependent_third_parties: Cold-chain monitoring vendor; text-message delivery service; refrigeration contractor; electric utility; internet provider
dependent_people_or_facilities: Owner-operator (single point of failure; the only alert recipient); walk-in cooler and freezer; condensing units

business_process: Cutting, grinding, and packaging to the cut sheet
description: Breaking carcasses to each owner's cut sheet; grinding and sausage; vacuum packaging; weighing and labeling every package "Not for Sale" with the owner's name
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Carcasses can age a few more days, but the slaughter operator delivers on fixed days and cooler space fills; every package must be marked "Not for Sale" immediately after preparation (9 CFR 316.16, 317.16); about $3,500 of processing fees a week in season
manual_workaround: Paper cut sheets taken by phone; preprinted "Not for Sale" label roll with the owner's name and cut written by hand; scale used without the printer
dependent_third_parties: Label software vendor; email and file provider; booking form vendor; mobile slaughter operator (delivery schedule)
dependent_people_or_facilities: Owner-operator (single point of failure); processing room

description: Calculating cure and brine for each customer batch; curing bacon and hams; running smokehouse cook programs for smoked sausage, bacon, and hams
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Cure amounts must stay within the limits in 9 CFR 424.21(c) (applied through 303.1(b)(1)); a wrong cure or an altered cook program can make product unsafe; product already in cure must move to the smokehouse on schedule; RPO 24 h is not supported today because cook programs and the cure sheet have no backup
manual_workaround: Cure from the supplier's printed chart; run the smokehouse from the controller panel using a printed copy of each program (to be created); hold any batch whose cure or cook record is in doubt
dependent_people_or_facilities: Owner-operator (single point of failure; responsible person for curing agents); smokehouse

description: Taking processing date requests and cut sheets; coordinating delivery days with the slaughter operator; texting owners when product is ready; pickup at the counter
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Owners and the slaughter operator plan days ahead; missed messages cause no-shows and cooler crowding; booking submissions also arrive by email
manual_workaround: Phone calls and texts from the phone; paper appointment book; pickup list printed from the custom records
dependent_third_parties: Booking form vendor; email and file provider; phone carrier

description: Keeping the custom records required by 9 CFR 303.1(b)(3) and Part 320; invoicing processing fees; card and check payments; tax records
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Records must be kept for 2 years after December 31 of the transaction year (9 CFR 320.3(a)) and shown to FSIS on request (300.6(b)(2)); payments can wait a few days; RPO 24 h is not supported today because the custom records spreadsheet has no backup or version history
manual_workaround: Paper receipt book; card reader works from the phone; rebuild the current month's records from kill sheet photos, cut sheets, and invoices
dependent_third_parties: Email and file provider; accounting SaaS vendor; card processor; bank; tax preparer
